prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D pixel-art explosion animation sprite sheet for a dark industrial action RPG. Create ONE transparent PNG atlas with EXACTLY 8 frames in a strict 4-column by 2-row equally spaced grid, read left to right then next row. Each cell is identical square size, no gutters. Overall canvas 2:1 aspect. Each explosion is completely isolated inside its cell, with transparent empty space around it, no crossing cell boundaries. Same ground anchor at horizontal center and 75% cell height in ALL frames, consistent camera three-quarter top-down view, consistent scale, animation expands then dissipates naturally. Frames: 1 tiny sharp cream-white ignition star; 2 abrupt irregular yellow-white hot burst with orange pointed tongues; 3 largest broad asymmetric explosive fireball, white-hot core, jagged orange/red lobes, a few dark steel fragments and tiny sparks shooting outward; 4 rolling orange fire with charcoal smoke starting behind; 5 dissipating red embers and broken gray-brown smoke lobes rising; 6 separated softer smoke wisps and sparse falling embers; 7 thin disconnected translucent smoke wisps, no fire; 8 almost vanished smoke remnants. Art direction: hand-painted crisp PIXEL ART, limited amber, burnt orange, deep red, charcoal and warm gray palette, irregular silhouette, NO circular rings or smooth vector blobs, NO realistic photograph, NO blur bloom, NO ground, NO shadows on a background, NO grid lines, NO frame numbers, NO text, NO checkerboard drawn into image. Genuine transparent alpha background, opaque bright fire and partially transparent late smoke. Leave at least 10% empty margin in every cell.
